id: title:georgemunyoro:drop the unbounded count from property autocomplete

review.posthog_relevance: Autocomplete response for HogQL property names; the database query previously could scan the entire taxonomy, while the new implementation orders by name and fetches only the limit plus one, then truncates, and sets the incomplete_list flag based on the fetched count.
